name: Tameeni Insurance
note: Wholly owned by Rasan Information Technology Company, a Saudi-listed fintech (Rasan IPO prospectus, May 2024; rasan.co IPO page calls Tameeni a flagship subsidiary). The prospectus named Rasan's direct 5%+ shareholders and stated there were no shareholders with indirect ownership of 5% or more; its post-offering table shows Impact Funds for Financial Technology Company at 13.06% and Assets Custody Development Impact Company at 4.49% (17.55% combined). Impact46 then announced its successful exit from Rasan through an accelerated bookbuild offering on 13 Mar 2025 (Argaam: https://www.argaam.com/en/article/articledetail/id/1797009), so who Rasan's current 5%+ holders are is not sourced. Proposed tier unrated until Rasan's current 5%+ holders are sourced. Al Riyadh announced Tameeni as a sponsor on 28 Aug 2025 (riyadhclub.sa).
